title: GOO GOO GA GA
blurb: Baby talk, repurposed as a weapon. The internet uses it to declare that somebody is being childish, to mock a bad take into total oblivion, or simply to derail a serious conversation with maximum efficiency and minimum effort. It works because it refuses the argument entirely rather than engaging with it — you cannot rebut a pacifier. Devastating, technically pre-verbal, and impossible to respond to with dignity. Deploy it when somebody has escalated a disagreement well past the point where the original subject was worth defending.
